scope: Twin Cities municipal-development signals for commercial electricians

candidates.project: Gallery Apartments — 7900 Xerxes Ave S / 3400 American Blvd W
candidates.signal: 270-unit multifamily development; broader two-phase plan 360 units
candidates.electricalThesis: Large new multifamily build implies substantial power distribution, lighting, fire/life-safety, low-voltage and site electrical scope.

candidates.signal: 33-unit townhome development
candidates.electricalThesis: Ground-up 33-unit residential construction creates repeatable branch, service, site-lighting and low-voltage scope.

candidates.project: Seagate campus expansion — 7850 Nord Ave S / 7801 Computer Ave S
candidates.signal: Campus expansion with preliminary and final development plans
candidates.electricalThesis: Technology-campus expansion is likely electrically intensive and suitable for commercial electrical pursuit.

candidates.project: 8030 Old Cedar Ave S retail conversion
candidates.signal: Rezoning for purpose of establishing a retail tenant
candidates.electricalThesis: Tenant improvement may create fit-out electrical scope, but construction size and timing are not sufficiently described.

candidates.signal: Rezoning of five properties to neighborhood office planned development
candidates.rejectReason: No specific construction project or electrical scope established by the cited municipal record.

candidates.project: 3700 & 3750 American Blvd E remote airport parking
candidates.signal: Reguiding, rezoning and CUP for remote airport parking facility
candidates.electricalThesis: Potential site lighting, controls, security and EV/charging scope, but build scope is not explicit.

candidates.signal: Subdivision of one lot into four lots
candidates.rejectReason: Plat signal alone does not establish a building project or electrical package.

candidates.signal: Four-story, 180-unit affordable apartment building
candidates.electricalThesis: Large ground-up multifamily project with clear commercial electrical package potential.

candidates.signal: Nine-unit detached townhome development
candidates.electricalThesis: Small but defined ground-up residential project; potentially relevant to mid-sized electrical contractors.

candidates.signal: Conditional use permit for cannabis manufacturing and indoor agriculture facility
candidates.electricalThesis: Indoor cultivation/manufacturing typically has meaningful lighting, HVAC-support, controls and power requirements.

candidates.signal: Cannabis manufacturing facility in existing office/warehouse building
candidates.electricalThesis: Industrial tenant conversion may require substantial service, process power, lighting and controls upgrades.

candidates.signal: Six-story mixed-use building, 50 dwellings and about 4,500 sf office
candidates.electricalThesis: Ground-up mixed-use project with explicit transformer/service needs and commercial permit path.

candidates.signal: New two-story approximately 6,400 sf building
candidates.electricalThesis: New institutional/community building with transformer and lighting-plan requirements.

candidates.signal: New five-story multifamily dwelling with 89 units
candidates.electricalThesis: Large new multifamily building with site-lighting and building systems scope.

candidates.signal: New four-story residential building
candidates.electricalThesis: Explicit transformer screening and photometric requirements confirm meaningful electrical/site scope.

candidates.signal: New seven-story mixed-use building
candidates.electricalThesis: Large mixed-use development with explicit exterior mechanical and transformer requirements.

candidates.signal: 34,140 sf three-story spa
candidates.electricalThesis: Large commercial spa build likely carries lighting, controls, service, equipment and specialty-power scope.

candidates.signal: Hospital alteration requiring conditional-use approval
candidates.electricalThesis: Healthcare alteration can be electrically intensive, although exact construction scope needs enrichment.

candidates.project: 1 Portland Ave / 10 Chicago Ave / 900 S 1st St
candidates.signal: Preliminary plat creating six lots
candidates.rejectReason: Subdivision/plat record does not itself establish a near-term building package.

candidates.signal: Development in shoreland overlay associated with park property
candidates.electricalThesis: Potential park/site electrical work exists, but project scope is insufficiently specific for immediate pursuit.

candidates.signal: Registered land survey application
candidates.rejectReason: Survey action without a defined construction project is not a trade opportunity.

candidates.signal: Minor subdivision
candidates.rejectReason: Subdivision alone lacks defined electrical construction scope.

candidates.signal: Comprehensive-plan and rezoning actions for production mixed-use
candidates.electricalThesis: Municipal land-use action indicates redevelopment activity, but project scope requires enrichment before outreach.

candidates.signal: Planned redevelopment with market-rate apartments and street-level retail
candidates.electricalThesis: Ground-up mixed-use redevelopment at a major intersection is a high-value commercial electrical signal.

candidates.signal: Three multifamily buildings totaling 447 new housing units under amended development agreements
candidates.electricalThesis: Multiple active multifamily buildings create substantial repeatable electrical packages.

candidates.signal: Construction underway; planned 1,000 housing units, jobs, parks and geothermal infrastructure
